title: Abba, Father of Rabbi Abba Mari
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot, chapter 9, halakhah 3, speaking there in Rabbi Acha’s name. In Peah, chapter 1, halakhah 1, folio 3b, Hyman says it reads in error “Abba, father of Rabbi Abba bar Mari”; he proposes Abba Mari. He places him in the Land of Israel, approximately of the fifth generation.[^1]

notes.text: The supplied ג: is rendered folio 3b, with the colon preserved as the side marker. The Guggenheimer digital Peah 1:1 has Rabbi Abba, father of Rabbi Abba bar Mari, reporting Rabbi Acha; Hyman’s proposed deletion of bar remains his emendation. His approximate fifth-generation placement is retained as his.
